n95e4eca4fa.headline: NYMEX Overview :  Oil Futures Trade Higher on US-Iran Tensions and Winter Storm Disruptions
n95e4eca4fa.summary: Oil futures traded higher at midday Wednesday on escalating US-Iran tensions and weather-related supply disruptions. The NYMEX March West Texas Intermediate contract was up.
n95e4eca4fa.why: WTI is the US crude benchmark traded on NYMEX, and both geopolitical risk and supply disruptions move its price.
n95e4eca4fa.why_moved: Escalating US-Iran tensions raise supply risk concerns, and winter storms disrupted supply, both of which support crude prices.

n21c8f4a8c0.headline: IMF approves final review for loan to Zambia, unlocking $190 million
n21c8f4a8c0.summary: The IMF board approved the final review of its sixth and final credit facility to Zambia, unlocking $190 million for the Southern African nation.
n21c8f4a8c0.why: IMF programmes provide balance-of-payments support and signal policy credibility to bond and currency investors in frontier economies such as Zambia.

n5852d02ba9.headline: London's FTSE 100 falls as investors rotate into US tech stocks ahead of Fed decision
n5852d02ba9.summary: The FTSE 100 declined on Wednesday, weighed down by banks and healthcare stocks, as it missed a tech-led rally on Wall Street. Investors were positioning ahead of a Fed decision.
n5852d02ba9.why: The FTSE 100 is the benchmark index of the largest companies listed in London, heavily weighted to banks, energy and healthcare.

impacts.name: FTSE 100
impacts.why: The index fell as investors shifted money from London blue chips into US tech stocks.

n8cbd0486b5.summary: Gold hovered above $5,500 on Wednesday as a weaker dollar accelerated the debasement trade.
n8cbd0486b5.why: Gold is a traditional store of value, and investors often buy it when they fear currency debasement or when the dollar weakens.

impacts.why: Gold traded above $5,500 as the dollar weakened and investors sought a hedge.

ne82cfc8027.headline: Saudi Arabia to Deny Airspace for Attacks Against Iran - Reports
ne82cfc8027.summary: Riyadh has assured Tehran it will not allow its airspace and territory to be used for attacks against Iran, a Saudi news agency reported. The report was carried by Sputnik International.
ne82cfc8027.why: Saudi Arabia is a major oil producer, and Gulf security tensions can affect oil supply risk and regional markets.

n2d88968b6b.headline: Households could get paid under plan to price pollution
n2d88968b6b.summary: Australia could raise $35 billion a year by putting a price on pollution, according to a plan reported by the wellingtontimes.com.au. The plan would also help households and businesses.
n2d88968b6b.why: Carbon pricing changes the cost of emissions for energy-intensive industries and can alter government revenue and investment decisions.

n577082a8b5.headline: Worry over ‘US military strike’ on Iran as Trump warns ‘time is running out’
n577082a8b5.summary: The US has moved the USS Abraham Lincoln and several guided missile destroyers into the region, raising concern over a possible US military strike on Iran.
n577082a8b5.why: Military escalation involving Iran can disrupt oil shipping through the Gulf and Strait of Hormuz, which affects global energy prices and risk sentiment.

n3b931b2489.headline: Athens Stock Exchange Hits 2009 Highs on 1.45% Rally
n3b931b2489.summary: The Athens Stock Exchange gained 1.45%, returning to 2009 levels. The rally came amid MSCI upgrade hopes and record trading volume.
n3b931b2489.why: The Athens exchange is Greece's main equity market, and MSCI classification changes can attract index-tracking investment flows.

n072462e2e3.headline: €750M Fiscal Space for Greece in 2026
n072462e2e3.summary: Greece gains €750 million in fiscal space for 2026 under new EU rules. The article covers conditions, limits and permissible uses, including tax relief and spending.
n072462e2e3.why: Fiscal space under EU rules determines how much Greece can spend or cut taxes without breaching budget constraints, which matters for sovereign debt investors.

nb345fd6db0.headline: Nasdaq edges up, S&P 500 flat as Fed brings no surprise
nb345fd6db0.summary: The Nasdaq rose slightly on chip stock gains while the S&P 500 ended almost unchanged after the Federal Reserve's policy decision.
nb345fd6db0.why: The Nasdaq and S&P 500 are the leading US equity benchmarks, and Federal Reserve decisions set the cost of money that influences valuations across markets.

impacts.why: The index ended almost unchanged following the Fed's decision.

ne34208d500.headline: Haditha-Baniyas Oil Pipeline Project Reviewed | Iraq Business News
ne34208d500.summary: Iraq has reviewed steps to implement the Haditha-Baniyas crude oil pipeline, focusing on technical and logistical studies. The project is intended to diversify export outlets and raise crude export capacity.
ne34208d500.why: Export pipelines determine how Iraq, one of OPEC's largest crude producers, gets its oil to market, which matters for global crude supply.

n6cb4edc361.headline: Aussie dollar breaks barrier as greenback loses shine
n6cb4edc361.summary: The Australian dollar broke through a key level against the US dollar as the greenback lost ground. Australians travelling to the US were reported to be benefiting.
n6cb4edc361.why: The Australian dollar is a widely traded currency whose moves against the US dollar affect import costs, travel and returns for global investors holding Australian assets.

nba4305ccda.headline: Genel Energy issues Trading and Ops Update | Iraq Business News
nba4305ccda.summary: Genel Energy issued a trading and operations update ahead of its full-year 2025 results, due March 18, 2026, noting production improved in the fourth quarter in Iraqi Kurdistan.
nba4305ccda.why: Genel Energy is an oil and gas producer with operations in Iraqi Kurdistan, and its output trends indicate the health of its upstream assets.

n721ca8dced.headline: IMF forecasts continued Australian growth into 2026
n721ca8dced.summary: The IMF expects steadier growth for Australia through 2026 as inflation eases and private demand strengthens. The outlook points to implications for households.
n721ca8dced.why: IMF growth forecasts shape investor expectations for the economy, interest rate settings and corporate earnings in a country.

na6b51cbf66.headline: Middle East worries over possible US strike on Iran one month after protests began
na6b51cbf66.summary: Middle East concern rose over a possible US military strike on Iran, one month after protests began. Iran's currency reached a new low at the same time.
na6b51cbf66.why: A weakening currency and heightened military risk raise inflation pressure and capital flight concerns in Iran's economy.

n7a27752424.headline: Rate rise pain all but certain after inflation shock
n7a27752424.summary: Hotter-than-expected inflation figures have led analysts to expect the Reserve Bank to lift rates as soon as next week. Upcoming decisions are seen as pressure on borrowers.
n7a27752424.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the cash rate that drives borrowing costs, bond yields and the Australian dollar across the economy.
n7a27752424.why_moved: Hotter-than-expected inflation has raised expectations of a near-term RBA rate hike, which tends to lift government bond yields and support the Australian dollar.

n01309575ce.headline: Row over government role fuelling inflation, rate rise
n01309575ce.summary: Critics say government spending blowouts will force the Reserve Bank of Australia to raise interest rates. The treasurer has responded to the claims.
n01309575ce.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the cash rate, which drives borrowing costs across the economy and the Australian dollar's yield appeal.

n782a87eda8.headline: Electric car sales edge above petrol in EU for first time
n782a87eda8.summary: Sales of fully electric cars have surpassed sales of petrol-only vehicles in the EU for the first time, according to ACEA data. The shift highlights growing momentum toward electrification.
n782a87eda8.why: The European Automobile Manufacturers' Association (ACEA) publishes the bloc's registration data, which shapes investment in electric vehicles and combustion-engine programmes.

na2a1035948.headline: Sir Keir Starmer to meet Xi Jinping on crucial day in Beijing
na2a1035948.summary: Prime Minister Keir Starmer will meet Xi Jinping in Beijing. A planned deal would provide for joint UK-Chinese law enforcement operations against people-smuggling gangs.
na2a1035948.why: UK-China diplomatic relations shape trade, investment and access to the world's second-largest economy for British businesses.

n96f07af440.headline: US finishes its withdrawal from the Paris Climate Agreement
n96f07af440.summary: The United States has officially finished its withdrawal from the Paris Climate Agreement.
n96f07af440.why: The Paris Agreement sets the framework for national emissions pledges, which influence energy policy and climate-related investment.

ncce32f1c17.summary: Intel shares rose after reports of foundry partnership talks with Nvidia and Apple, with investors also weighing insider buying and AI optimism against the chipmaker's recent losses.
ncce32f1c17.why: Intel is a major US chipmaker that is building out its contract manufacturing (foundry) business to compete with TSMC and Samsung.

n54e9ec77ec.headline: Extended trading hours to face test of foreign investors
n54e9ec77ec.summary: Amid an unprecedented stock market rally, South Korea is moving to lengthen stock trading hours. The push is part of a broader effort to attract more foreign investors.
n54e9ec77ec.why: Trading hours determine when global investors can access a market, so changes affect liquidity and foreign participation in Korean equities.

nbd4273f4fe.headline: Lee floats idea of imposing sugar levy to support regional, public health care
nbd4273f4fe.summary: President Lee Jae Myung proposed a sugar levy to curb sugar intake and bolster public health care funding. The idea was floated on Wednesday.
nbd4273f4fe.why: Sugar levies are taxes on sugary products that governments use to raise revenue and influence consumption. They affect beverage and food producers.

ne15e75963a.headline: When political will favoured a billionaire: A foreign media exposé of a dirty deal
ne15e75963a.summary: A foreign media report argued that the agreement would generate enormous profits for Gautam Adani while delivering a poor outcome for Bangladesh and India.
ne15e75963a.why: The Adani Group is a major Indian conglomerate with infrastructure and power interests across South Asia. Its contracts attract scrutiny from regulators and investors.

nc99b940c2f.headline: Global Hotel Alliance reports record $3.2b revenue in 2025
nc99b940c2f.summary: Global Hotel Alliance, headquartered in the UAE, announced record revenue of $3.2 billion for 2025. The alliance is a hotel loyalty and distribution network.
nc99b940c2f.why: Global Hotel Alliance is a hotel loyalty alliance that links brands worldwide. Its revenue reflects travel and hospitality demand.

nd5abc86100.summary: A report by the Free Market Foundation highlights increasing Bitcoin adoption in South Africa as a tool to hedge against inflation and gain financial independence.
nd5abc86100.why: Bitcoin adoption trends in emerging markets like South Africa reflect growing interest in alternative assets amid inflation and currency volatility.

n22b45d831a.summary: Bayardo Arce, a longtime economic adviser to Nicaraguan President Daniel Ortega, was found guilty of money laundering by a Nicaraguan court.
n22b45d831a.why: Legal actions against senior government advisers can affect political stability and investor confidence in Nicaragua's economy.

n3f96016f99.headline: AT&T bets on fiber, spectrum deals to forecast annual profit above expectations
n3f96016f99.summary: AT&T expects annual profit to exceed market forecasts, driven by wireless and fiber network expansion and upcoming spectrum deals to enhance 5G and high-speed internet services.
n3f96016f99.why: AT&T is a leading U.S. telecom operator whose network investments and spectrum acquisitions influence competitive dynamics in the telecom sector and investor sentiment.
n3f96016f99.why_moved: AT&T's profit forecast above expectations on network investments led to a share price increase.

nd3f4424414.summary: Dutch semiconductor equipment maker ASML announced record orders and expects strong growth in 2026, countering fears of an investment bubble.
nd3f4424414.why: ASML is a critical supplier of advanced lithography machines essential for semiconductor manufacturing, making its order trends a key indicator of the chip industry and technology investment cycle.

nf5cdb2ab8a.headline: Feature: Sudanese industry showcases resilience in recovery despite ongoing internal conflicts
nf5cdb2ab8a.summary: Sudanese industry in Atbara is promoting economic recovery and national production despite ongoing internal conflicts, highlighted by the 'Made in River Nile' exhibition.
nf5cdb2ab8a.why: Industrial resilience in conflict zones is crucial for economic stability and rebuilding efforts.
